verdict.rationale: dlt/dltHub docs reference scheduling capability ("Schedule, refresh, backfill, and observe runs" via `dlthub deploy`, an orchestration product that lets teams "schedule, backfill, and chain" pipelines, and a GitHub Actions deployment guide which supports cron-based triggers), giving evidence that sync frequency can be controlled per pipeline. However the pack lacks explicit detail on cron expression syntax, sub-hour scheduling granularity, or manual-trigger UI/CLI mechanics, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of these scheduling claims. Missing for 10: explicit cron/sub-hour scheduling documentation, manual trigger mechanism details, and third-party validation of scheduling behavior.
